pgStatStatements.query: update rooms set active_participant_count=$1,capacity=$2,description=$3,experience_level=$4,game_id=$5,host_user_id=$6,place=$7,region=$8,room_type=$9,is_rulemaster_led=$10,start_at=$11,status=$12,title=$13,updated_at=$14,version=$15 where id=$16 and version=$17
select cr1_0.id,cr1_0.created_at,cr1_0.messages_purged_at,cr1_0.purge_after,cr1_0.room_id,cr1_0.updated_at from chat_rooms cr1_0 where cr1_0.room_id=$1

select count(*)
from rooms
where title like $2
  and status = $3
  and start_at > $1

select r1_0.id,r1_0.active_participant_count,r1_0.capacity,r1_0.created_at,r1_0.description,r1_0.experience_level,r1_0.game_id,r1_0.host_user_id,r1_0.place,r1_0.region,r1_0.room_type,r1_0.is_rulemaster_led,r1_0.start_at,r1_0.status,r1_0.title,r1_0.updated_at,r1_0.version from rooms r1_0 where (r1_0.status='RECRUITING' and r1_0.start_at<=$1) or (r1_0.status='CLOSED' and r1_0.start_at<=$2)

with operation as materialized (
    select clock_timestamp() as operation_time
), claimable as (
    select event.id as id, event.available_at as available_at, operation.operation_time as operation_time
    from notification_outbox_events event
    cross join operation
    where event.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
      and event.available_at <= operation.operation_time
    order by event.available_at asc, event.id asc
    limit 1
    for update of event skip locked
)
select id as id, available_at as "availableAt", operation_time as "operationTime"
from claimable

with operation as materialized (
    select clock_timestamp() as operation_time
)
select extract(epoch from (
    operation.operation_time - (
        select min(event.available_at)
        from notification_outbox_events event
        where event.status in ('PENDING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
          and event.available_at <= operation.operation_time
    )
)) * 1000
from operation
select pg_stat_statements_reset()
